description: Summarize a UTF-8 CSV header and row count without exposing cell values.
inputs: One CSV path after --. Accepts a UTF-8 BOM; rows must match header width.
outputs: JSON column names, row count and blank row count. Duplicate rows are preserved.
verification: Unit tests cover BOM, duplicate rows and invalid row widths.
recovery: Read-only. Correct the input format and rerun; original file is never changed.
